name: CIS Kubernetes Benchmark
description: CIS Kubernetes Benchmark v1.8.0, section 5 (Policies): the recommendations evaluable from a single pod spec. Numbering verified against aquasecurity/kube-bench cfg/cis-1.8/policies.yaml.

controlSets.name: 5.1 RBAC and Service Accounts
controlSets.description: Pod-evaluable subset of CIS section 5.1. 5.1.1-5.1.5 and 5.1.7-5.1.13 concern RBAC objects and are not evaluable from a pod spec.

controls.name: 5.1.6 Ensure that Service Account Tokens are only mounted where necessary

checks.name: Service account token auto-mount disabled
checks.description: The pod sets automountServiceAccountToken: false. Absent means the ServiceAccount's setting, whose default is true, so absent fails.
checks.remediation: Set spec.automountServiceAccountToken: false on pods that do not call the Kubernetes API.

controlSets.name: 5.2 Pod Security Standards
controlSets.description: Per-workload form of the CIS 5.2 admission recommendations. 5.2.1 (an active policy control mechanism) is cluster-level and not evaluable from a pod spec.

controls.name: 5.2.2 Minimize the admission of privileged containers

checks.name: No privileged containers
checks.description: No container, init container or ephemeral container sets securityContext.privileged: true. Absent defaults to false.
checks.celExpression: has(object.spec) && (((has(object.spec.containers) ? object.spec.containers : []) + (has(object.spec.initContainers) ? object.spec.initContainers : []) + (has(object.spec.ephemeralContainers) ? object.spec.ephemeralContainers : [])).all(c, !(has(c.securityContext) && has(c.securityContext.privileged) && c.securityContext.privileged == true)))
checks.remediation: Remove securityContext.privileged: true from every container; grant only the specific capabilities required.

controls.name: 5.2.3 Minimize the admission of containers wishing to share the host process ID namespace

checks.name: Host PID namespace not shared
checks.description: spec.hostPID is absent or false. Absent defaults to false.

controls.name: 5.2.4 Minimize the admission of containers wishing to share the host IPC namespace

checks.name: Host IPC namespace not shared
checks.description: spec.hostIPC is absent or false. Absent defaults to false.

controls.name: 5.2.5 Minimize the admission of containers wishing to share the host network namespace

checks.name: Host network namespace not shared
checks.description: spec.hostNetwork is absent or false. Absent defaults to false.
checks.remediation: Remove spec.hostNetwork: true; expose the workload through a Service instead.

controls.name: 5.2.6 Minimize the admission of containers with allowPrivilegeEscalation

checks.name: Privilege escalation disallowed
checks.description: Every container sets securityContext.allowPrivilegeEscalation: false. Absent defaults to true, so absent fails. Pods with spec.os.name: windows are exempt (the field is Linux-only and forbidden there).
checks.celExpression: has(object.spec) && ((has(object.spec.os) && has(object.spec.os.name) && object.spec.os.name == 'windows') || ((has(object.spec.containers) ? object.spec.containers : []) + (has(object.spec.initContainers) ? object.spec.initContainers : []) + (has(object.spec.ephemeralContainers) ? object.spec.ephemeralContainers : [])).all(c, has(c.securityContext) && has(c.securityContext.allowPrivilegeEscalation) && c.securityContext.allowPrivilegeEscalation == false))
checks.remediation: Set securityContext.allowPrivilegeEscalation: false on every container, init container and ephemeral container.

controls.name: 5.2.7 Minimize the admission of root containers

checks.name: Containers do not run as root
checks.description: As Pod Security Admission decides it: the effective runAsNonRoot (container, else pod) must be explicitly true for every container, and no runAsUser may be 0 at pod level or at any container level. runAsNonRoot: true is what makes the kubelet refuse an image whose USER is root, so a non-zero runAsUser alone does not substitute for it; a container setting runAsNonRoot: false is rejected whatever the effective UID; and pod-level runAsUser: 0 is rejected even if every container overrides it.
checks.celExpression: has(object.spec) && (!(has(object.spec.securityContext) && has(object.spec.securityContext.runAsUser) && object.spec.securityContext.runAsUser == 0) && ((has(object.spec.containers) ? object.spec.containers : []) + (has(object.spec.initContainers) ? object.spec.initContainers : []) + (has(object.spec.ephemeralContainers) ? object.spec.ephemeralContainers : [])).all(c, ((has(c.securityContext) && has(c.securityContext.runAsNonRoot)) ? c.securityContext.runAsNonRoot == true : (has(object.spec.securityContext) && has(object.spec.securityContext.runAsNonRoot) && object.spec.securityContext.runAsNonRoot == true)) && !(has(c.securityContext) && has(c.securityContext.runAsUser) && c.securityContext.runAsUser == 0)))
checks.remediation: Set runAsNonRoot: true and a non-zero runAsUser in the pod securityContext, and do not override them per container.

controls.name: 5.2.8 Minimize the admission of containers with the NET_RAW capability

checks.name: NET_RAW capability not held
checks.description: Container runtimes grant NET_RAW by default, so each container must drop NET_RAW or ALL, must not add it back (NET_RAW, CAP_NET_RAW or ALL), and must not be privileged. Pods with spec.os.name: windows are exempt.
checks.celExpression: has(object.spec) && ((has(object.spec.os) && has(object.spec.os.name) && object.spec.os.name == 'windows') || ((has(object.spec.containers) ? object.spec.containers : []) + (has(object.spec.initContainers) ? object.spec.initContainers : []) + (has(object.spec.ephemeralContainers) ? object.spec.ephemeralContainers : [])).all(c, !(has(c.securityContext) && has(c.securityContext.privileged) && c.securityContext.privileged == true) && has(c.securityContext) && has(c.securityContext.capabilities) && has(c.securityContext.capabilities.drop) && c.securityContext.capabilities.drop.exists(d, d.matches('(?i)^((cap_)?net_raw|all)$')) && !(has(c.securityContext.capabilities.add) && c.securityContext.capabilities.add.exists(a, a.matches('(?i)^(cap_)?(net_raw|all)$')))))
checks.remediation: Add capabilities.drop: ["ALL"] (or at least NET_RAW) to every container and do not add NET_RAW back.

controls.name: 5.2.9 Minimize the admission of containers with added capabilities

checks.name: No added capabilities
checks.description: No container has a non-empty securityContext.capabilities.add. Absent adds nothing.
checks.celExpression: has(object.spec) && (((has(object.spec.containers) ? object.spec.containers : []) + (has(object.spec.initContainers) ? object.spec.initContainers : []) + (has(object.spec.ephemeralContainers) ? object.spec.ephemeralContainers : [])).all(c, !(has(c.securityContext) && has(c.securityContext.capabilities) && has(c.securityContext.capabilities.add) && size(c.securityContext.capabilities.add) > 0)))
checks.remediation: Remove capabilities.add from every container; redesign the workload if it needs a capability.

controls.name: 5.2.10 Minimize the admission of containers with capabilities assigned

checks.name: All capabilities dropped
checks.description: Every container lists "ALL" in securityContext.capabilities.drop, compared exactly as Pod Security Admission compares it: "all" in any other case does not satisfy the restricted profile and the pod is rejected, so it fails here too. Absent keeps the runtime default set, so absent fails. Pods with spec.os.name: windows are exempt.
checks.celExpression: has(object.spec) && ((has(object.spec.os) && has(object.spec.os.name) && object.spec.os.name == 'windows') || ((has(object.spec.containers) ? object.spec.containers : []) + (has(object.spec.initContainers) ? object.spec.initContainers : []) + (has(object.spec.ephemeralContainers) ? object.spec.ephemeralContainers : [])).all(c, has(c.securityContext) && has(c.securityContext.capabilities) && has(c.securityContext.capabilities.drop) && c.securityContext.capabilities.drop.exists(d, d == 'ALL')))
checks.remediation: Add capabilities.drop: ["ALL"] to every container, init container and ephemeral container.

controls.name: 5.2.11 Minimize the admission of Windows HostProcess containers

checks.name: No Windows HostProcess containers
checks.description: Neither the pod nor any container sets securityContext.windowsOptions.hostProcess: true. Absent defaults to false.
checks.celExpression: has(object.spec) && (!(has(object.spec.securityContext) && has(object.spec.securityContext.windowsOptions) && has(object.spec.securityContext.windowsOptions.hostProcess) && object.spec.securityContext.windowsOptions.hostProcess == true) && ((has(object.spec.containers) ? object.spec.containers : []) + (has(object.spec.initContainers) ? object.spec.initContainers : []) + (has(object.spec.ephemeralContainers) ? object.spec.ephemeralContainers : [])).all(c, !(has(c.securityContext) && has(c.securityContext.windowsOptions) && has(c.securityContext.windowsOptions.hostProcess) && c.securityContext.windowsOptions.hostProcess == true)))
checks.remediation: Remove windowsOptions.hostProcess: true; run node-level Windows agents outside tenant namespaces.

controls.name: 5.2.12 Minimize the admission of HostPath volumes

checks.name: No hostPath volumes
checks.description: No entry in spec.volumes is a hostPath volume. Absent volumes pass.
checks.remediation: Replace hostPath volumes with emptyDir, a PersistentVolumeClaim, a ConfigMap or a CSI volume.

controls.name: 5.2.13 Minimize the admission of containers which use HostPorts

checks.name: No host ports
checks.description: No container port sets a non-zero hostPort, and spec.hostNetwork is not true. The hostNetwork test sits outside the ports loop on purpose: a hostNetwork pod shares the host network namespace, so every port its processes bind is a host port whether or not the spec declares one, and the API server defaults hostPort to containerPort for any port it does declare. Declaring no ports is therefore not a defence, and a hostNetwork pod fails even with no ports.
checks.celExpression: has(object.spec) && (!(has(object.spec.hostNetwork) && object.spec.hostNetwork == true) && ((has(object.spec.containers) ? object.spec.containers : []) + (has(object.spec.initContainers) ? object.spec.initContainers : []) + (has(object.spec.ephemeralContainers) ? object.spec.ephemeralContainers : [])).all(c, !has(c.ports) || c.ports.all(p, !(has(p.hostPort) && p.hostPort != 0))))
checks.remediation: Remove hostPort from container ports and expose the workload through a Service.

controlSets.name: 5.4 Secrets Management
controlSets.description: Pod-evaluable subset of CIS section 5.4. 5.4.2 (external secret storage) is not evaluable from a pod spec.

controls.name: 5.4.1 Prefer using Secrets as files over Secrets as environment variables

checks.name: Secrets not exposed as environment variables
checks.description: No container has an env entry with valueFrom.secretKeyRef or an envFrom entry with secretRef.
checks.celExpression: has(object.spec) && (((has(object.spec.containers) ? object.spec.containers : []) + (has(object.spec.initContainers) ? object.spec.initContainers : []) + (has(object.spec.ephemeralContainers) ? object.spec.ephemeralContainers : [])).all(c, (!has(c.env) || c.env.all(e, !(has(e.valueFrom) && has(e.valueFrom.secretKeyRef)))) && (!has(c.envFrom) || c.envFrom.all(f, !has(f.secretRef)))))
checks.remediation: Mount Secrets as volumes and read them from files instead of env/envFrom.

controlSets.name: 5.7 General Policies
controlSets.description: Pod-evaluable subset of CIS section 5.7. 5.7.1 (administrative boundaries) is a namespace-design recommendation, not a pod property.

controls.name: 5.7.2 Ensure that the seccomp profile is set to docker/default in your Pod definitions

checks.name: Seccomp profile RuntimeDefault or Localhost
checks.description: As Pod Security Admission decides it. A pod-level seccompProfile type of Unconfined fails outright, whatever the containers override it with: PSA forbids it at baseline as well as restricted, and any container added later without an override inherits it. Otherwise each container's effective profile (container, else pod) must have type RuntimeDefault, or type Localhost with a non-empty localhostProfile -- Localhost without localhostProfile is rejected by the API server itself (validateSeccompProfileField in pkg/apis/core/validation/validation.go). Unconfined fails; absent everywhere fails (the kubelet default is Unconfined). Pods with spec.os.name: windows are exempt (seccomp is Linux-only).
checks.celExpression: has(object.spec) && ((has(object.spec.os) && has(object.spec.os.name) && object.spec.os.name == 'windows') || (!(has(object.spec.securityContext) && has(object.spec.securityContext.seccompProfile) && has(object.spec.securityContext.seccompProfile.type) && object.spec.securityContext.seccompProfile.type == 'Unconfined') && ((has(object.spec.containers) ? object.spec.containers : []) + (has(object.spec.initContainers) ? object.spec.initContainers : []) + (has(object.spec.ephemeralContainers) ? object.spec.ephemeralContainers : [])).all(c, (has(c.securityContext) && has(c.securityContext.seccompProfile)) ? (has(c.securityContext.seccompProfile.type) && (c.securityContext.seccompProfile.type == 'RuntimeDefault' || (c.securityContext.seccompProfile.type == 'Localhost' && has(c.securityContext.seccompProfile.localhostProfile) && c.securityContext.seccompProfile.localhostProfile != ''))) : (has(object.spec.securityContext) && has(object.spec.securityContext.seccompProfile) && (has(object.spec.securityContext.seccompProfile.type) && (object.spec.securityContext.seccompProfile.type == 'RuntimeDefault' || (object.spec.securityContext.seccompProfile.type == 'Localhost' && has(object.spec.securityContext.seccompProfile.localhostProfile) && object.spec.securityContext.seccompProfile.localhostProfile != '')))))))
checks.remediation: Set spec.securityContext.seccompProfile.type: RuntimeDefault and do not override it with Unconfined per container.

controls.name: 5.7.3 Apply SecurityContext to your Pods and Containers

checks.name: SecurityContext applied to pod and containers
checks.description: spec.securityContext is present and non-empty, and every container, init container and ephemeral container has a non-empty securityContext.
checks.celExpression: has(object.spec) && (has(object.spec.securityContext) && size(object.spec.securityContext) > 0 && ((has(object.spec.containers) ? object.spec.containers : []) + (has(object.spec.initContainers) ? object.spec.initContainers : []) + (has(object.spec.ephemeralContainers) ? object.spec.ephemeralContainers : [])).all(c, has(c.securityContext) && size(c.securityContext) > 0))
checks.remediation: Set a pod-level securityContext and a container-level securityContext on every container.

controls.name: 5.7.4 The default namespace should not be used

checks.name: Not in the default namespace
checks.description: metadata.namespace is set and is neither empty nor "default". Absent fails: an unset namespace resolves to "default" unless the client context says otherwise.
checks.remediation: Deploy the workload into a dedicated namespace and set metadata.namespace explicitly.
